mapper.select: select (select coalesce(sum(qty_ok),0) from mes_report where date(report_time) = (select max(date(report_time)) from mes_report)) as output, (select coalesce(sum(qty),0) from mes_work_order where status <> 'finished') as planQty, (select coalesce(sum(completed_qty),0) from mes_work_order) as doneQty, (select coalesce(sum(qty_ok),0) from mes_report) as okQty, (select coalesce(sum(qty_ng),0) from mes_report) as ngQty, (select coalesce(round(avg(oee),1),0) from mes_equipment) as oee, (select coalesce(sum(qty - completed_qty),0) from mes_work_order where status in ('running','waiting','warning')) as wip, (select count(*) from mes_work_order where status = 'waiting') as shortageOrders, (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from mes_stock) as stockAmount, (select count(*) from mes_alarm where status = 'active') as activeAlarms

select w.line_code as lineCode, coalesce(sum(w.qty),0) as planQty, coalesce(sum(w.completed_qty),0) as doneQty, coalesce(sum(w.ng_qty),0) as ngQty, (select coalesce(round(avg(e.oee),1),0) from mes_equipment e where e.line_code = w.line_code) as oee from mes_work_order w group by w.line_code order by w.line_code
select date_format(report_time, '%H') as h, sum(qty_ok) as v from mes_report group by h order by h
select date_format(report_time, '%m-%d') as d, sum(qty_ok) as v from mes_report where report_time >= date_sub((select max(report_time) from mes_report), interval #{days} day) group by d order by d

select material_name as name, sum(qty) as qty, max(safety_qty) as safety, round(sum(qty) / nullif(max(safety_qty),0) * 100, 1) as rate from mes_stock where safety_qty > 0 and warehouse_code in ('WH-RM','WH-LINE') group by material_code, material_name order by rate asc limit 8

select order_code as orderCode, product_name as productName, qty, completed_qty as completedQty, ng_qty as ngQty, line_code as lineCode, station, status, priority from mes_work_order where status in ('running','waiting','warning') order by work_order_id limit 20

select alarm_code as alarmCode, equipment_name as equipmentName, level, content, date_format(alarm_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') as alarmTime, status from mes_alarm where status = 'active' order by alarm_time desc

select (select coalesce(sum(qty - received_qty),0) from mes_purchase_order) as purchaseInTransit, (select count(*) from mes_purchase_order where status in ('ordered','partial','overdue')) as pendingDelivery, (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from mes_stock) as stockAmount, (select coalesce(round(avg(on_time_rate),1),0) from mes_supplier) as onTimeRate, (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from mes_purchase_order where date_format(order_date,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) as monthPurchase, (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from mes_sales_order where date_format(order_date,'%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(),'%Y-%m')) as monthSales, (select count(*) from mes_voucher where u8c_status = 'failed') as u8cFailed, (select count(*) from mes_voucher where u8c_status <> 'success') as u8cPending, (select count(*) from mes_collab where status in ('abnormal','overdue')) as exceptions

select collab_code as collabCode, collab_type as collabType, supplier_name as supplierName, material_name as materialName, qty, date_format(plan_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as planDate, status, content from mes_collab where status in ('pending','running') order by plan_date limit 12

select collab_code as collabCode, collab_type as collabType, supplier_name as supplierName, material_name as materialName, qty, date_format(plan_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as planDate, status, content from mes_collab where status in ('abnormal','overdue') order by plan_date limit 12

select stock_id as stockId, material_code as materialCode, material_name as materialName, warehouse_name as warehouseName, qty, safety_qty as safetyQty, status from mes_stock where safety_qty > 0 and qty < safety_qty order by qty / safety_qty asc limit 12

select voucher_id as voucherId, voucher_code as voucherCode, biz_type as bizType, biz_code as bizCode, amount, account_period as accountPeriod, status, u8c_status as u8cStatus, date_format(sync_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as syncTime, message from mes_voucher where status = 'pending' or u8c_status <> 'success' order by voucher_id desc limit 15
select date_format(order_date, '%Y-%m') as m, sum(amount) as v from mes_purchase_order group by m order by m
select date_format(order_date, '%Y-%m') as m, sum(amount) as v from mes_sales_order group by m order by m

select issue_type as name, count(*) as v, coalesce(sum(qty),0) as qty from mes_quality_issue where found_time >= date_sub((select max(found_time) from mes_quality_issue), interval #{days} day) group by issue_type order by v desc
select line_code as lineCode, round(avg(oee),1) as oee from mes_equipment group by line_code order by line_code

select w.line_code as lineCode, coalesce(sum(w.qty),0) as planQty, coalesce(sum(w.completed_qty),0) as doneQty, coalesce(sum(w.ng_qty),0) as ngQty, round(sum(w.completed_qty) / nullif(sum(w.qty),0) * 100, 1) as rate, (select coalesce(round(avg(e.oee),1),0) from mes_equipment e where e.line_code = w.line_code) as oee from mes_work_order w group by w.line_code order by w.line_code

select (select coalesce(sum(qty_ok),0) from mes_report where report_time >= date_sub((select max(report_time) from mes_report), interval #{days} day)) as output, (select coalesce(sum(qty_ok),0) from mes_report) as totalOutput, (select coalesce(sum(qty_ng),0) from mes_report) as ngQty, (select coalesce(round(avg(oee),1),0) from mes_equipment) as oee, (select count(*) from mes_quality_issue) as issueCount, (select count(*) from mes_alarm) as alarmCount
